claim: EV-0062 binds the frozen 8-path gem5 and 14-path runtime source lanes to the canonical VEGA_X86 gem5 binary, independent Clang/GCC runtime test trees, and a direct user-facing OpenCL vecadd executable. With a scrubbed environment and no endpoint or LD_LIBRARY_PATH, the executable compiles vecadd.cl, spawns the managed gem5 daemon, submits one 1024-item kernel, receives C-only D2H, and passes the CPU oracle. The daemon's exact three-event trace records four workgroups, sixteen waves, 448 instructions, 2048 reads, 1024 writes, 16 stores/1024 store lanes, CRC32C 3210199849, durable type20, UNMAP, clean exit, and no fallback. This is a one-shot session only; multi-dispatch, Triton runtime, model, TP/CCL, and stable multi-token inference remain false.
